line.text: The story of the epic's royal house begins with Dushyanta, of Puru's line.

hunt.text: One day he rode out to hunt, with hundreds of horses and elephants.

deeper.text: Chasing deer, hungry and thirsty, he came to another forest.

lovely.text: By the river Malini, in a wood loud with birds, stood the hermitage of the sage Kanva.

left.text: He left his army at the forest's edge, and laid aside the signs of a king.

chant.text: He walked in among sacred fires and chanting.

empty.text: But the sage's own place was empty.

came.text: A young woman in a hermit's dress came out and welcomed him. Her father, she said, was gathering fruit.

cliff.text: Her father? Kanva was sworn to celibacy. Who was she?
